author: mark
text:
Add GitHub Actions CI workflow running make ci

Workflow triggers on push and pull_request to main on ubuntu-latest,
installs the stable Rust toolchain with rustfmt + clippy, caches the
cargo registry and target/, installs cargo-tarpaulin for the 100%
coverage gate, and runs make ci (fmt-check + lint + coverage). README
gets a CI status badge near the top and a one-line note about CI
scope. Public-repo readiness: green CI on README signals quality.
